info.title: GEN Vidsheet Operations
info.description: Canonical vidsheet operation schema (GEN-4764, epic GEN-4760). GENERATED from the Rails routes, controller strong-parameter lists, and model validations/enums — do not edit by hand; run `bin/rails vidsheet_schema:generate`. This is the WIRE contract (what Rails accepts); model-facing tool schemas derive from it minus the ordering axis — strip every field marked `x-ordering-axis: true` when projecting to agent tool definitions.
